title: Segmental and total ROM of intact L1-S1 (in vitro, no preload): FE, LB, torsion

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: total (both directions summed) segmental ROM and L1-S1 total, in vitro specimens; mean ± SD

source.authors: Renner SM, Natarajan RN, Patwardhan AG, Havey RM, Voronov LI, Guo BY, Andersson GBJ, An HS
source.n: 10 cadaveric L1-S1 spines (in vitro part; FE model data not extracted)
source.sample: human cadaver lumbar spines L1-sacrum, discs grade II or better on MRI

protocol.summary: In vitro L1-S1 (Loyola/Hines lab, follower-load technique of Patwardhan 1999). Moments applied at L1: 8 Nm flexion / 6 Nm extension (with 0 or 800 N follower preload), ±6 Nm lateral bending and ±4 Nm torsion (no preload); loads simulating FE and LB remained vertical (so effective moment varies); ~14 N axial load from the moment apparatus. No preconditioning other than path optimisation. FE and LB rotations by biaxial inclinometers on each vertebra, torsion by Optotrak (resolution 0.1 deg). Total segmental motion = sum of the two directions in each plane.
how_to_simulate: Model L1-S1; fix S1; apply moments at L1 by vertical force couples (8 Nm flexion, 6 Nm extension; ±6 Nm lateral bending; ±4 Nm torsion)
Add ~14 N axial load (apparatus); for the preload test add an 800 N follower load passing near each segment's centre of rotation (tangent to the lordosis)
Report per-level and L1-S1 total ROM as the sum of both directions (flexion+extension, left+right LB, left+right torsion)
protocol.notes: Ten specimens; per-level n assumed 10 (not stated per figure). The lab and authors overlap Patwardhan 2003; specimens may be shared.

extraction.check_notes: Bars located by colour (in vitro = blue/purple), calibrated on gridlines; SD = mean of upper/lower whisker half-lengths.
